## Live now

::: {.card-grid}

::: {.tool-card #rustmapper}
[Live]{.status .ok}

### RustMapper
White pine blister rust risk for high-elevation five-needle pines in the western US, past (1980-2023) and projected (2030-2099). Data: [historical](products/rustmapper-historical.qmd) · [projections](products/rustmapper-projections.qmd).

[Open RustMapper](https://angelchen.shinyapps.io/WPBR/){.btn .btn-primary .btn-sm} [Source](https://github.com/Malone-Disturbance-Ecology-Lab/WPBR_app)
:::

::: {.tool-card #enp-fires}
[Live]{.status .ok}

### Everglades fire history
Browse fires in Everglades National Park by year, type and size. Data: [Fire in the Everglades](products/everglades-fire-history.qmd) · [ENP fire perimeters](products/enp-fire-perimeters-1948-2019.qmd).

[Open the app](https://angelchen.shinyapps.io/ENP_fires/){.btn .btn-primary .btn-sm} [Source](https://github.com/Malone-Disturbance-Ecology-Lab/ENP_app)
:::

:::

### Global Mangrove Dynamics Explorer
Visualize mangrove expansion, canopy densification, forest age and structural change over time.
:::

::: {.tool-card}
[Planned]{.status}

### Everglades Resilience Explorer
Coastal vegetation transitions, degradation, salinity and restoration outcomes. Built on the [SESE land-cover layers](products/sese-landcover.qmd).
:::

::: {.tool-card}
[Planned]{.status}

### Disturbance and Recovery Explorer
Hurricane impacts, wildfire history and post-disturbance recovery. Built on [Fire in the Everglades](products/everglades-fire-history.qmd).
:::

::: {.tool-card}
[Planned]{.status}

### Ecosystem Methane Explorer
Measurement locations, flux direction, seasonality, methods and drivers. Built on the [NEON gradient-flux benchmark](products/neon-gradient-flux-benchmark.qmd).
:::
